title: overlay_check's Demo_Replay literal still omits growth_on — growth demos' PP_DEBUG verification frames re-sim growth-OFF
evidence:
cfg := Demo_Replay{
		name = d.name,
		use_fixture = d.use_fixture,
		qos_fixture = d.qos_fixture,
		advance_gate_on = d.advance_gate_on, // 6.2 r2 W2: the B1 flag-threading's residual site — the overlay verb re-sims the gate demos gate-ON too, or its verification frame shows the wrong sim
		session = {goal = d.win_goal, cap_ms = d.lose_cap_ms, health_on = d.health_on, surge_win_pct = d.surge_win_pct},
	}
detail: The literal the fold fixed is the same 'residual cfg site' for the 5.1 growth flag: demo_apply_setup sets `state.growth_enabled = cfg.growth_on` (false here), so overlay-check on growth.dem renders a sim without map growth — the wrong verification frame.
recommended_fix: Add `growth_on = d.growth_on` to overlay_check's Demo_Replay literal (mirror run_demo's), so the overlay verb re-sims growth demos the way the app runs them.
